'use strict'
const test=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict')
test("orderBoxes exact results",()=>{
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(3,10,4),2)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(0.1,0.4,0.1),3)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(0,1.1,0.1),11)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1.01,1.04,0.01),3)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(12,10,4),0)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(0,Number.MIN_VALUE,Number.MIN_VALUE),1)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(0,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,1),Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
})
test("orderBoxes refusals",()=>{
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(NaN,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,NaN,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,NaN),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(Infinity,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,Infinity,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,Infinity),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(-Infinity,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,-Infinity,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,-Infinity),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes('2',3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,'2',1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,'2'),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(undefined,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,undefined,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,undefined),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(null,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,null,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,null),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(true,3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,true,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,true),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes({},3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,{},1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,{}),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes([],3,1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,[],1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(1,3,[]),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").orderBoxes(0,Number.MAX_VALUE,Number.MIN_VALUE),RangeError)
})
test("stockVariance results and rejections",()=>{
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,0),0)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(-0,0),0)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,-0),0)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(7,3),4)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(3,7),-4)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(9,9),0)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,0),Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),-Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1),1)
assert.equal(require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),-1)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(-1,0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(1.5,0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance('1',0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(NaN,0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(Infinity,0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1,0),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,-1),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,1.5),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,'1'),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,NaN),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,Infinity),RangeError)
assert.throws(()=>require("../src/localBrain/examples/stock.js").stockVariance(0,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1),RangeError)
})
